protocol.engine_fix: Rule or normaliser defect; expected label retained.
protocol.complete_profile: Unambiguous missing fact stated in the case rationale; fixture completed.
protocol.relabel: Expected label not derivable from supplied facts; adjudicated to Insufficient Information.
